quests.title: Rain Gauge Railway Route Report
quests.kidDirection: Use the route map and weather clues to plan a tiny railway report with a clear first-next-final order.
quests.adultNote: Clip the page to a firm folder and invite the child to collect quiet window observations between writing lines.
quests.takeHomeLine: Save this route report as a travel-page starter for a weather railway story.

pageSections.heading: Route Map Clues

The tiny railway should carry the sample toward ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Weather Sequence

Finally, the garden report explains ____________________.

quests.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Rest Stop Log
quests.kidDirection: Compare three tidepool lab notes, choose the most useful observation, and write what the timekeepers should check next.
quests.adultNote: Use one short table session and let the child point to the strongest clue before drafting the ending.
quests.takeHomeLine: Save this lab log as a careful-observation page from the road trip.

quests.title: Seed Library Hotel Map Catalog
quests.kidDirection: Turn a folded route map into three seed catalog clues and arrange them into a beginning, middle, and ending.
quests.adultNote: Set out the page with two quiet color choices and ask the child to circle the clue that should begin the story.
quests.takeHomeLine: Save this map catalog page as a take-home seed-library scene plan.

quests.title: Compass Craft Visit-Day Route Map
quests.kidDirection: Design a story route with scene stops, revise the turning point, and prepare one polished line to share kindly.
quests.adultNote: Offer a quiet table window and let the child decide whether to read one finished line or simply save the page.
quests.takeHomeLine: Save this route map as the planning page for a longer Compass Craft Academy story.
